pattern: if {f:Filter} dying causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger , that ability triggers an additional time

examples.text: If an artifact creature dying causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.
If a Goblin dying causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.

counterExamples: If an artifact creature entering causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.
If an artifact creature dying causes a triggered ability of a permanent an opponent controls to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.
If an artifact creature dying causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers two additional times.
